item.title: [CRWD] Is the Fortinet Stock Rally Sustainable?
item.description: Fortinet stock (FTNT) surged to $104 in extended trading following its first quarter 2026 earnings report on May 6, 2026. This "beat and raise" performance saw revenue hit $1.85 billion, representing 20.1% year-over-year growth and surpassing analyst estimates of $1.77 billion. While the market frequently rewards top-line growth, the underlying shift toward AI-driven security suggests a fundamental change in Fortinet's trajectory.
